notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome120 impersonation) worked for robots.txt and sitemap*.xml but every real content page (homepage, catalog/*.jsp) returned Akamai 403 'Access Denied' with an edgesuite.net reference and an injected bot-manager sensor script. tier (b) Playwright headless Chromium also got 403 'Access Denied' on the homepage (headless fingerprint caught by the same Akamai bot manager). robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-ai specific disallow (only a generic User-agent:* partial disallow list plus full blocks for meta-externalagent/meta-webindexer/Baiduspider), so tier (c) was permitted; escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (authenticated human browser session) which loaded all pages normally. All data below was gathered via tier (c). TREE: built from the 'for-the-home.jsp' Home department landing strip (Kitchen & Dining, Bedding, Bath, Home Decor, Rugs) plus each department/category page's own sub-category strip (top nav links with distinct CN= query params), and cross-checked against sitemap_catalog_*.xml for a hidden 'Window Treatments' (curtains) category that is not shown in the Home Decor top strip but exists at Category:Window Treatments+Department:Home Decor. Storage lives under a separate Department:Storage & Cleaning > Category:Storage & Organization (reached via the 'Storage' tile inside the Home Decor strip). QTY: each leaf's own page header count in the 'CategoryName (N)' / 'Show N Items' UI, read via the accessibility tree (find/read_page) or full page text, one page load per leaf, no aggregation across leaves. EXCLUDED: 'Storage Furniture' (Activity:Storage, Department:Furniture) - site explicitly places it under the Furniture department, so per storage.md the Furniture task owns it, not this one. 'Bath Accessories' (4,115 items: soap dispensers, wastebaskets, mirrors, toilet brushes, tumblers, tissue covers, shower mats) - primarily non-textile/non-storage decorative-functional bath products, no textile or storage primary purpose. 'Kids' Bathroom' room-filter page - same underlying products already counted under Bath Towels/Shower Curtains/Bath Accessories, would duplicate. 'Wall Decor & Art' subcategories (Wall Art, Wall Accents, Picture Frames, Mirrors, Wall Shelves & Hooks, Wall Clocks) - no dedicated Tapestries/Fabric Wall Hanging category exists so nothing textile to record; wall shelves are Wall Decor per the site's own hierarchy, not Storage. 'Cooking Utensils & Tools' and 'Dinnerware & Serveware' (Kitchen & Dining) - checked, no kitchen-textile (towel/apron) category exists as a distinct navigable node on this site, so no row forced. 'Curtain Rods & Hardware' (Category:Window Treatments, Product:Curtain Rods & Hardware) - hardware, excluded per textile.md Sec.5. FLAGGED (kept, not excluded): 'Shower Curtains' (Category:Shower Curtains & Accessories) - the site bundles curtain-hardware (rods/hooks/liners) into the same listing as fabric shower curtains under one category page; the count could not be split without fabricating, so confidence=MEDIUM. 'Food & Kitchen Storage' - the site's Kitchen Storage category also includes some lunch bags/totes (personal-carrying items) mixed with genuine food-storage containers; confidence=MEDIUM. The six Window Treatments sub-rows (2-Pack/Blackout/Room Darkening/Light Filtering/Sheer/Valance) are the site's own distinct nav-linked style facets of the same 'Curtains & Drapes' product type and are not mutually exclusive (a product can appear in more than one), so they are recorded individually as the site presents them (not summed) with confidence=MEDIUM.
